Definition: from G692; to be idle, i.e. (figuratively) to delay:--linger.
BiblicalUsage: The word means to be idle, to linger or delay, and it appears once, when Peter says the judgment of the false teachers does not linger, and their damnation does not slumber.
TheologicalSignificance: God's judgment may seem to linger, but Peter says it does not, and the false teacher's end is already awake.
